patchNotes: Custom emote animations now download automatically when you open Emotes. RoweMod verifies and caches the official pack, then refreshes the emote and dance lists without restarting. Existing verified packs work offline. Download status and Refresh Emotes provide progress and retry; failed downloads preserve existing files and clean up temporary files. Includes the four-button pie menu with Replay on the right, native outfit restoration, radio controls, and the riding/replay tools from 3.3.5. Automatic in-game download and playback still need a fresh game test. Custom emotes remain local; TV playback and multiplayer media remain experimental.
